== Acquisition ==
Part of [[Turai Ossa (disguise)|Turai Ossa]]'s replacement [[skill bar]] during [[The Battle of Jahai]] mission.

== Related skills ==
* {{skill icon|Dragon Slash}} ([[elite]])

== Notes ==
* This skill is normally used with 14 in [[Swordsmanship]], but the attribute rank can be affected by [[Weakness]] and a sword pommel [[Of Attribute|of Swordsmanship]].
* When combined with [["For Great Justice!" (Turai Ossa)|"For Great Justice!"]] it is possible to hit with a Dragon Slash constantly for 20 seconds.
